experiments.title: Recover a broken three-service order workflow
experiments.goal: Create an order, intentionally discover a missing receipt, repair it, verify all services and clean up
experiments.expectedFailure: S3 404 for the receipt before it exists
experiments.caveat: This is a synthetic workflow, not actual payment processing or event-driven Lambda execution

experiments.title: S3 contract: break, repair and verify
experiments.goal: Observe an expected missing-key error, create the object, verify the exact bytes and list operation, then clean up
experiments.caveat: Validates only the S3 operations executed locally, not full S3 fidelity

experiments.title: DynamoDB last-write-wins demonstration
experiments.goal: Write a draft value, verify it, overwrite the same key, prove the current value changed and clean up
experiments.caveat: An intentional overwrite demonstration, not a concurrency, transactional or IAM test

experiments.title: Prove SNS event delivery into SQS
experiments.goal: Create a real topic and queue, configure an explicit SNS-to-SQS policy, subscribe, publish a synthetic event, receive and acknowledge it, then remove the subscription, queue and topic
experiments.caveat: Demonstrates one emulated SNS-to-SQS delivery and acknowledgement, not exactly-once messaging, live AWS IAM enforcement or Lambda execution

experiments.title: Provision and inspect an isolated EC2 network
experiments.goal: Create an emulated VPC, subnet and security group; describe the resources, delete them in dependency order and verify the VPC is absent
experiments.caveat: Emulated control-plane resource lifecycles only; no EC2 compute instances, network traffic or real VPC networking

experiments.title: Exercise an EventBridge event-bus API lifecycle
experiments.goal: Create an event bus, verify it exists, submit a synthetic event with no targets, delete the bus and verify absence
experiments.caveat: PutEvents acknowledgement only; no targets, event routing, consumer invocation or delivery guarantees are tested

experiments.title: Write, read and delete a synthetic SSM parameter
experiments.goal: Write a uniquely named synthetic String parameter, verify the exact value, remove the parameter and confirm it is absent
experiments.caveat: Plaintext synthetic parameters only; not SecureString, IAM authorization, encryption or production configuration security

experiments.title: Create, read and delete a synthetic secret
experiments.goal: Create a uniquely named synthetic secret, compare its value locally without returning it as evidence, request deletion and verify it is absent from the active inventory
experiments.caveat: Synthetic values only; a pending-deletion record may persist after DeleteSecret. This does not test KMS encryption, IAM access control, rotation or real secret handling
